claims.statement: The slot correction was applied to the wrong feed and did not resolve the held-order condition
claims.limitation: Indicates our available corrective actions (revert, replay, slot correction) lack sufficient visibility into the multi-system carrier integration to fix the root cause unilaterally

claims.statement: The 186 stuck orders require carrier system intervention; our available mitigations (rule revert, allocation replay, slot correction) have each failed, indicating the root cause mechanism is on the carrier integration side and requires carrier-side diagnostics and fixes
claims.limitation: Evidence strongly suggests carrier system issue, but the specific failure point in the carrier integration has not been isolated

next_action.rationale: Root cause: carrier system integration failure (root_002) at approximately 05:58, causing 47-minute confirmation latency against 30-minute slot deadline. Three reversible mitigations attempted and failed: (1) revert allocation rules - ineffective, (2) replay allocations - ineffective, slots closed, (3) correct slot windows - ineffective, wrong feed. The carrier system failure requires carrier-side investigation. Final assessment: 186 orders held; root cause carrier_feed_lag established; mitigation requires Carrier Operations investigation of 05:58 failure point, confirmation queue diagnostics, and carrier system remediation. Escalate to Carrier Ops with evidence of timing and latency metrics.
